title: US Sales Manager for Children's Online Courses
description:
What you'll do: Deliver 1:1 online trial lessons, understand each child's needs, recommend the right Kodland program, and help families make a confident enrollment decision.
Schedule: 20-25 hrs/week on average, mostly weekday afternoons/evenings + daytime weekends (US hours)
Pay: Fixed rate per completed trial + performance bonuses - clear, transparent structure
Support: Live onboarding, guided practice, and a short assessment before you start with real families
If this sounds like your kind of role, here's the full picture 👇
1. About Kodland 👨‍💻👩‍💻
Kodland is an international online school helping kids aged 8-17 build real digital skills - Python, Roblox, Minecraft, Digital Creativity, and more. We work with students and families across the US, Europe, the UK, CIS, Latin America, MENA, and beyond, all through live 1:1 or small-group Zoom classes with a project-based approach.
Our mission: help kids become confident, curious thinkers who are comfortable with technology and problem-solving.
🔗 Learn more about Kodland
2. A Day in the Life of a TCM 🎬
Curious what this actually looks like day to day? This short video shows a typical TCM schedule, how a real trial lesson unfolds, and what the conversation with parents feels like.
👉 Watch it before applying - it's the fastest way to know if this role fits your lifestyle.
3. What You'll Actually Be Doing 🎧
Each trial lesson, you'll:

• Meet the child and at least one parent on Zoom

• Build rapport and ask the right questions to understand the child's background, interests, and goals

• Lead a short hands-on activity (simple coding, game logic, or digital task) using ready-made materials

• Recommend the best-fit program based on what you observe

• Answer questions, address concerns, and guide the family to a clear decision

This role blends three skill sets:
🎓 Teaching - explaining clearly and keeping kids engaged
🗣 Communication - listening well and adapting to each family
💼 Sales - showing value and confidently closing when it's a good fit
This isn't a scripted call-center job. You'll get structure and materials, but you're expected to think on your feet and lead the conversation.
4. Schedule & Availability 🕒

• Weekdays: mainly 14:00-21:00 CDT

• Weekends: mainly 11:00-18:00 CDT

• 5 days/week , with 1 weekday off + 1 weekend day off

Exact hours are negotiable, but we need consistent weekly availability so we can plan ahead and keep families from waiting.
We ask you to honor the slots you commit to - but we're human about it. Life happens; just give us a heads-up so we can adjust smoothly.
5. Pay & Earning Potential 💶
Independent contractor role, paid twice a month , built on two parts:

• Base pay: $8 per completed trial (up to $9.50 based on your grade)

•
Bonus: 5-10% of your monthly sales - the better your conversion rate, the higher your %

📌 Admin hours are paid at the same rate as trial classes.

What that looks like in real numbers (based on internal averages, part-time):

• 🌱 New to the role: ~$700/month

• 📈 Steady performers: $1,200+/month

• 🏆 Top performers: up to $2,200/month

You'll get regular feedback, coaching, and webinars to help you grow - income increases with skill, consistency, and effort, but it's a real, achievable path even part-time.
Requirements
Must-Haves

• Clear, confident spoken English that US parents can easily follow

• A laptop/PC with working webcam and mic

• Stable internet for smooth video calls

• A quiet space to work with your camera on

• 20-25 hrs/week available during peak hours (weekday US afternoons/evenings + weekend days)

• You genuinely enjoy talking with both kids and parents

Nice-to-Haves

• Experience in sales, customer service, customer success, tutoring, or coaching

• Experience working with kids and/or parents

• Comfortable managing your own schedule remotely

Highlights
Run engaging 1:1 online trial lessons with US kids, help parents choose the right program, and earn per lesson + bonuses - up to $

title: REMOTE Nurse Practitioner - Virginia (VA) License
description:
Nurse Practitioner
Integrated Women’s Care (IWC) Employment Type: Full-Time
FLSA Status: Exempt
Compensation: $55 - $70 / hour, based on geographic location
Reports To: Nurse Practitioner Manager
Work Location: Remote - work must be completed within the United States
Schedule: Between 7:00 am - 7:00 pm, patient local timezone
You built your career caring for women at a time when the healthcare system largely ignored them. You know HRT, you understand the complexity of perimenopause, and you’ve spent years earning the clinical instincts it takes to actually get this right. Now you want to do it at scale - for more patients, with fewer barriers, and in a practice model that matches how you already think and work.
That’s what Midi is. A fully virtual, fast-paced clinical environment built specifically around women’s midlife health - and designed for NPs who are ready to practice at their best.
THE ROLE
You’ll carry a full patient panel, managing perimenopause, menopause, weight, sexual health, mood, and sleep - all virtually. This is ongoing, relationship-based care, which means your patients come back to you - visit after visit, over months and years. You’ll prescribe and independently manage HRT (estrogen, progesterone, testosterone), evaluate patients for pharmacologic weight management including GLP-1 therapies, and make autonomous clinical decisions every day.
It’s a high-volume environment. Documentation, follow-through, and productivity benchmarks are part of the job - and the NPs who thrive here don’t fight that reality, they’re built for it. If you’re the kind of clinician who runs efficient visits without sacrificing warmth, closes every loop without being reminded, and moves comfortably between patients and platforms, you’ll feel at home here.
WHO THRIVES HERE
Our most successful NPs tend to share a few things in common:

• They are genuinely passionate about women’s midlife health - this isn’t a stopover, it’s their calling

• They are fluent with technology - EHR, video, AI scribe tools, Slack, clinical decision support - and they adapt quickly when tools change

• They hold themselves to a high standard without needing to be managed toward it

• They can carry a full panel, hit productivity targets, and still make every patient feel like the only one

• They’ve practiced independently long enough to trust their own clinical judgment

• They believe that listening deeply and documenting accurately are both forms of excellent care

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

• Active board certification: FNP-C / FNP-BC or WHNP-BC

• 3+ years independently managing perimenopause and menopause patients

• 3+ years independently prescribing and titrating HRT

• 3+ years managing a continuous NP patient panel - building ongoing relationships and making autonomous clinical decisions over time

• 3+ years of synchronous telemedicine experience

• 1+ year evaluating and prescribing pharmacologic weight management therapies, including GLP-1 agonists

• Multiple active state licenses (DEA preferred)

• Preferred: certification in Menopause (MSCP) and/or Obesity Medicine

WHY MIDI

• A patient population that is engaged, informed, and deeply grateful for real care

• Full clinical autonomy within a supportive, protocol-driven framework

• Fully remote with scheduling between 7am-7pm patient local time

• Desirable benefits package

• Accredited training eligible for Continuing Education (CE)

• Clinician Professional Development Allowance

• Paid time off

• A team that takes women’s health as seriously as you do

WORKING ENVIRONMENT
This is a fully remote position requiring reliable high-speed internet access and the ability to work effectively in a virtual environment. The role involves prolonged computer use, including extended periods of sitting, video conferencing, and electronic documentation. To support patient access and business needs, occasional evening, weekend, or multi-time-zone coverage may be required.

From managing sponsorship deliverables and event logistics to coordinating speakers, meetings, travel, and onsite execution, you’ll help turn event strategy into experiences that drive visibility, engagement, and business impact.

title: Director, Product Management – Direct-to-Patient Pharmacy Platform
description:
Who is Prescryptive?
Prescryptive is the healthcare technology company enabling the direct access marketplace for prescription drugs. Our platform aligns incentives so affordability, choice, and patient access become the natural outcome of a functioning system. Learn more about us by following us on LinkedIn or visiting Prescryptive.com.
About the Role
We are hiring a Director, Product Management - Direct-to-Patient Pharmacy Platform to own the product strategy and roadmap for Prescryptive’s Direct-to-Patient platform.
This is a senior individual contributor product leadership role for someone who understands how prescriptions actually move through the U.S. healthcare system - from prescriber initiation to ePrescription routing, benefit verification, adjudication, pharmacy fulfillment, and patient access. The ideal candidate also brings direct experience building or supporting pharmaceutical manufacturer patient services and hub programs, with a deep understanding of the operational workflows that connect prescribers, patients, specialty pharmacies, and manufacturers throughout the therapy access journey.
This is not a traditional “write user stories and groom the backlog” product role. You will shape platform strategy, translate complex manufacturer and pharmacy requirements into scalable product capabilities, and work across commercial, engineering, pharmacy operations, compliance, and external partner teams.
You will report to the SVP of Digital Prescription Services and work regularly with manufacturer partners, pharmacy networks, integration partners, and Prescryptive’s executive leadership team.
Why This Role Matters
Pharmaceutical access is changing quickly. Manufacturers are looking for new ways to connect patients to therapy, reduce friction, improve affordability, and create more direct, data-informed access models.
Prescryptive is building the infrastructure to support that shift.
In this role, you will help define a platform category - not simply optimize an existing workflow. You will work on a live platform already processing tens of thousands of prescription transactions daily, with direct exposure to senior commercial and manufacturer stakeholders.
The right person will have the opportunity to shape how Direct-to-Patient prescription access works across manufacturers, pharmacies, prescribers, and patients.
What You’ll Own

•
Product strategy for the Direct-to-Patient platform: Define and drive the roadmap for Prescryptive’s Direct-to-Patient platform, balancing scalable shared infrastructure with the configurability required by different manufacturer programs, pharmacy partners, and patient access models.

•
Prescription workflow and platform design: Own product definition across the prescription lifecycle, including ePrescription initiation, NCPDP SCRIPT messaging, prescription routing, benefit verification, prior authorization, adjudication, patient experience workflows, pharmacy selection, and fulfillment.

•
Manufacturer program translation: Partner with commercial and manufacturer-facing teams to turn complex market access, benefit design, channel strategy, and patient support requirements into durable platform capabilities.

•
Manufacturer Patient Services & Hub Platform Strategy: Partner with pharmaceutical manufacturers and internal stakeholders to translate patient support program requirements into scalable platform capabilities. Design products that enable manufacturer hub services, including patient enrollment, benefits investigation, prior authorization, copay and free drug programs, specialty pharmacy routing, patient communications, adherence support, and other access workflows that improve therapy initiation and continuation.

•
Configurable product architecture: Help determine what should be standardized, what should be configurable, and where program-specific customization creates value or unnecessary complexity.

Help teens feel heard and families feel supported from their first conversation.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
ABOUT US

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll own design for the heart of Tebi: the point of sale, kitchen display and payment flows that restaurants use every minute of service.

On a busy Friday night, one restaurant might run Tebi on an iPad at the bar, handhelds on the floor, payment terminals at the tables, screens in the kitchen and a printer at the pass. All of it has to work together, often for staff who only started that week. A lot of merchants like Tebi because it's as easy to use as a consumer app, so training new staff takes less time. You'll help keep it that way as the product grows.

You'll work with a product manager and five engineers, and across teams on the work we share.

Some of the problems waiting for you:

- Making onboarding so simple that a restaurant can get set up and run its first service with confidence.

- Making the kitchen display valuable even for kitchens that still print tickets.

As a design team, we want to ship work we're proud of, own our seat at the table, and push the company to aim higher.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own design for the core aspects of hospitality service. The sales flow on the POS, the floor plan during service, the kitchen display, receipts and cash management.

- Make paying the easy part. Checkout, splitting the bill, tips and service charges, settling up, and the terminals staff use to take payment.

- Own the design system in the native app. We want the whole Tebi platform to share one design DNA. You'll own how it shows up in our native app: the design system, its components, and the details of how they're built.

- Work AI-first and design AI into the product. Prototype in code, ship UI yourself, and help reinvent Tebi to be more helpful and proactive, like setup that configures itself for each restaurant.

- Champion our merchants. Get close to the people who run their business on Tebi, and help the whole company understand them too.

- Shape what we build. You'll work with the PM and engineers on which problems we take on and how we solve them.

- Help the whole team level up. We're a small team, so your experience goes a long way. You'll mentor, give feedback and help other designers do their best work.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- You've led design end to end on a product people depend on, and other designers looked to you on craft.

- You make complex things feel simple. Your work holds up for someone using it for the first time, in a rush, with a queue in front of them.

- You're at home in the complicated system underneath: states, edge cases, money, and what happens when things go wrong.

- You use AI tools in your work, or you're keen to learn fast. It's a requirement of the role, but we don't expect you to be an expert on day one.

It's a bonus if you've worked on:

- Native apps for tablets, phones or handhelds

- Payments or fintech

- Products that span several devices or real hardware

- Building or running a design system

- Hospitality. If you've worked a shift in a restaurant, bar or café, you'll know what the people using Tebi are up against.

This probably isn't the role for you if you're happiest designing dense desktop tools for expert users. The person using your work could be on their very first shift.

People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://ww

title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
description:
ABOUT ANTITHESIS:

We've been quietly reinventing how the world thinks about software reliability, and we're just getting started! At Antithesis, we start at the foundations - we run entire software systems inside a deterministic simulation and break them in every way imaginable. Every issue then comes with a perfect reproduction, so you can identify root causes fast instead of spending days trying to recreate what went wrong.

 

The rise of AI-generated code has made this work more urgent than ever. Agents can write code faster than any human, but speed doesn't matter much when the output is buggy, stuck in review, or slipping through undetected. The verification bottleneck is real, it's growing, and solving it is one of the most consequential problems in software right now. That's what you'd be working on.

 

We're well-funded and deeply technical, the kind of place where the hardest problems get the most attention and the best ideas win regardless of who has them. If you want to do work that actually moves the needle on how reliable software can be, keep reading.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Antithesis is looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our engineering team. This role primarily focuses on the Notebook - the reactive computing platform that all Antithesis UX is built on top of. As a Notebook Engineer, you will do a mix of deeply technical and heavily product-focused work.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- Make improvements to a reactive engine for executing Javascript (imagine Jupyter where everything auto recalcs).

- Own a new feature, from the front end to the data layer. This includes adding features as needed to our custom database (or proxy, or API server) to get the feature done.

- Create Property Based Tests and Antithesis workloads to test the things you create.

- Work with our product managers to design and scope features.

- Develop build and deployment logic in Nix.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

- Experience working with complex customer facing-products.

- Be very comfortable with Typescript, and ready to pick up a bit of Rust work.

- Have strong technical skills and a solid programming background in algorithms and data structures.

- Experience building static and dynamic websites

- Understanding of how the internet and browsers work

- (bonus) experience with Nix

- (bonus) have ideas about leveraging AI effectively

- (bonus) a prior history with PBT

The Role
The SRE Manager is the operating leader of a new cross-product SRE team at BeyondTrust , standing up and running the AWS GovCloud environments that bring additional BeyondTrust products into our FedRAMP authorization. Reporting to the VP of Application Engineering, this role owns the reliability, change control, and continuous-compliance machinery for those environments so that product feature teams can stay focused on product delivery.
This is a player-coach role. The right person has staff-level technical depth: they can critically review Terraform, pipeline definitions, and architecture proposals, have personally built and operated this machinery, and can carry context in an incident. That depth is combined with real people-management experience: they have hired, grown, and run a small SRE or DevOps team, and they own the team's delivery, not just its architecture. The engineering execution sits with the team; the manager stays close enough to the keyboard to lead it credibly.
The first-year mission is concrete: build and operate the AWS GovCloud environments that bring the covered products into our FedRAMP authorization, with the automation to keep them continuously compliant under FedRAMP 20x, where evidence is machine-readable, re-verified every few days, and reported monthly.
Our feature teams own product delivery. This role exists so they can focus on it. The SRE Manager takes permanent ownership of the shared operational work that would otherwise fall on feature teams as toil: the GovCloud environments, production operations, release and update machinery, and the compliance evidence pipeline for the covered products.
The team this role leads is an engineering team that owns operations, not an operations team. Its product is automation; operations is the input. Every manual procedure performed twice is a candidate for elimination, and the team's success is measured by the operational work it has made unnecessary, not the tickets it has closed. Hands-on operational work is capped at roughly half of team capacity; the rest goes to engineering the work away. Defending that split against day-to-day pressure is the manager's job.

• Own the CI/CD pipelines the GovCloud environments require (build, signing, artifact management, quality and security gates) and cloud cost visibility for the covered accounts

Production and change operations

• Own release and update machinery for cloud fleets: mandatory security updates, staged and jittered rollout windows, cluster-coordinated installs, and verification that a patch actually landed everywhere it was scoped to

title: Senior Tax Analyst
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
The Senior Tax Analyst will support the domestic tax operations of Veeva and will serve as the primary preparer of the income tax provision, coordinate income tax compliance workflows with external partners, and take full ownership of the internal and external information request processes. Additionally, the candidate will drive non-income tax compliance and support tax account reconciliations.

What You’ll Do

• Prepare quarterly and annual global ASC 740 tax provision, ensuring accuracy and compliance.

• Execute calculations for tax implications related to ASC 718 Stock-Based Compensation, 162(m), and other tax provision components.

• Support tax accounting control compliance under Sarbanes-Oxley.

• Own the internal and external information request process for tax provision, compliance, and audits.

• Execute detailed reviews of income tax return workpapers and returns prepared by external service providers, including verifying book/tax differences, state apportionment, and required disclosures.

• Coordinate the compliance timeline and execute a detailed review of all corporate income tax extensions and quarterly estimated tax workpapers prepared by external service providers.

• Share operational responsibility for the accurate, timely calculation and processing of related tax payments to guarantee zero late or missed filings and payments.

• Drive the non-income tax operational pipeline, ensuring accurate, timely filing of federal and state and local business licenses, gross receipts, and payments with zero missed deadlines.

• Draft initial responses to federal and state notices, tax audits, and compile required documentation to support inquiries from authorities.

• Prepare monthly general ledger tax account reconciliations and necessary journal entries.

• Conduct research and provide insightful analysis on tax implications of specific transactions.

Requirements

• 3+ years of hands-on experience in federal and state income tax compliance and reporting, including a minimum of 2 years in a CPA firm.

• Foundational preparation expertise in ASC 740 tax provision models.

• A sharp analytical mindset with a knack for problem-solving.

• Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills to meet tight deadlines.

• Proficient in Excel.

Nice to Have

• A degree in Finance or Accounting (B.S./B.A.).

• CPA License or a Master’s in Taxation.

• Experience with Big 4 firms or in a multinational corporate setting.

• Previous exposure to Netsuite.

Interviewing with Veeva

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

• If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior - IA Generativa e Agentes
description:
A Leega é uma empresa focada no atendimento eficiente e inovador em seus clientes.
Isso não poderia ser diferente com o nosso principal combustível: as pessoas!
Nossa cultura é inspiradora e nossos valores estão presentes no dia a dia: ética e transparência, excelência de qualidade, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade econômica, social e ambiental, relações humanas e credibilidade.
Buscamos profissionais inovadores que sejam movidos por desafios e focados em resultados.
Se você busca uma empresa dinâmica e parceira e que investe em seus colaboradores através de capacitação constante, a Leega é o lugar para você!
>> A LEEGA É PARA TODOS, ficaremos muito felizes em ter você em nosso time. Venha fazer parte da nossa história e da construção do nosso futuro.
Cadastre-se agora mesmo em nossas vagas!
Buscamos um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior com foco em IA Generativa para atuar em um projeto de construção de cinco agentes de IA para um grande cliente do setor de saúde e varejo farmacêutico. Os agentes automatizam processos de back-office: abertura de lojas, fiscalização sanitária, inteligência regulatória, compras e cadastro de planos de saúde.
Os agentes são criados por prompt na plataforma de IA do cliente e consultam bases de conhecimento via RAG (Azure OpenAI e MongoDB Vector Search). Eles se integram a sistemas corporativos por APIs, MCPs e automações RPA, e conversam com as áreas de negócio pelo Microsoft Teams.
Você será a pessoa responsável pela inteligência dos agentes, em uma squad com arquiteto de soluções, desenvolvedor e analista de negócios. O projeto trata dados sensíveis e passa por comitê de arquitetura e segurança; por isso, governança, LGPD e rastreabilidade fazem parte do trabalho desde o primeiro dia.
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

• Desenvolver e versionar os prompts de sistema dos agentes: papel e escopo, guardrails, ações permitidas, prazos e SLAs, controle de fluxo em processos de longa duração, política de chamada de tools, formato de saída e escalonamento humano.

• Preparar e estruturar as bases de conhecimento para RAG: normas regulatórias, políticas internas, RFPs e regras operacionais. O trabalho inclui limpeza, divisão em seções, metadados de vigência e organização por categorias e grupos de acesso.

• Avaliar a qualidade da recuperação (recall@k, isolamento entre grupos de acesso) e ajustar a estratégia de RAG.

• Construir fluxos de OCR e extração de informação de documentos (PDFs, fotos e manuscritos), com métricas de qualidade e tratamento de documentos ilegíveis.

• Implementar serviços de anonimização e mascaramento de dados pessoais, além de guardrails de entrada (anti prompt injection) e de saída (schema, vazamento de dados, ações proibidas).

• Montar golden sets e um harness de avaliação de prompts, com regressão a cada versão e medição de acurácia e custo por caso.

• Avaliar e homologar modelos de LLM de diferentes provedores por tipo de tarefa, aplicando práticas de FinOps de IA: roteamento entre modelos leves e robustos, batch e prompt caching.

• Criar os agentes na plataforma do cliente em conjunto com o time técnico, e apoiar testes integrados, homologação com usuários (UAT) e operação assistida.

• Documentar decisões técnicas e apoiar o material submetido ao comitê de arquitetura (custos, segurança e tratamento de dados).

Obrigatórios:

• Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

• 4 anos ou mais de experiência em ciência de dados ou machine learning, sendo parte em projetos com IA Generativa.

• Experiência prática com LLMs: engenharia de prompts, function calling/tools, saída estruturada (JSON Schema) e agentes.

• Experiência com RAG: embeddings, bancos vetoriais, busca híbrida, reranking e avaliação de recuperação.

• Python para experimentação, avaliação e tratamento de dados.

• Construção de datasets e métricas de avaliação para soluções com LLM (acurácia, precisão/recall, LLM-as-judge).

title: English to Latvian Review Lead for UI, Marketing & Product Content
description:
About Welo Global 
Welo Global is a leader in multilingual AI, technology, and content solutions serving over 2,000 clients in 300 languages. The company combines globally scaled multilingual infrastructure, including a network of over 500,000 linguists and domain experts, with advanced NLP, computational linguistics, and best-in-class compliance backed by seven ISO certifications. Welo Global’s five brands-Welocalize (multilingual content and localization services for global enterprises), Park IP (intellectual property and patent translation services for law firms and corporate legal teams), Welo Life Sciences (regulated language and compliance-aligned content solutions for pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical device organizations), Adapt (multilingual performance-led digital marketing agency), and Welo Data (multilingual data generation, evaluation, and human data infrastructure for AI systems)-serve distinct customer segments with purpose-built expertise, fit-for-purpose solutions, and supporting technology. weloglobal.com 

The Role 
We are seeking an experienced English into Latvian Review Lead to serve as the language quality owner and primary client-facing linguistic expert for a leading global technology client. 
You will own the locale’s interpretation of the client’s quality standards and make sure that the Post-Editing Lead, Post Editors, and Reviewers all work to the same shared understanding of “good”. You will be the main point of contact for the client’s Language Manager on quality discussions, arbitration, and escalations, and you will drive consistency, quality governance, and continuous improvement across UI, marketing, product, informational, legal, and support content. 
Project Details 
- Location: Remote (based in one of the approved countries below)
- Expected volume: Approximately 24 hours per month
- Employment type: Freelance / Independent Contract
- Task type: Language Lead Support
- Content types: UI, Marketing, Informational, Legal, Product, Support
- Language pair: English into Latvian 
What You Will Do 
-Analyse requirements: Review every style guide and glossary update, assess which quality categories and content types it affects, and record the changes. Track what the client’s Language Manager actually corrects and says in calibration and quality calls, not only what is written down.
-Relay expectations: Run regular alignment roundtables with the language community and publish a structured monthly quality digest covering performance, priority improvement areas, style guide updates, and notable errors and arbitration outcomes.
-Manage review quality actively: Coach Reviewers one-to-one using specific examples, run shadowing sessions, and deliver training built from real alignment data.
-Improve the standard: Turn recurring justification patterns into well-reasoned style guide proposals, and share cross-locale patterns with the Welocalize Quality Manager.
-Maintain alignment with the client: Treat Language Manager decisions as the standard, raise concerns with evidence at the right forum, and aim for fewer surprises over time.
What You Will Own
-The locale’s review service score, including RQE audit and alignment performance
-The community’s shared understanding of quality 
-The integrity of the arbitration record, ensuring that every arbitration sent to the client is valid and well-evidenced
-The working relationship with the client’s Language Manager, including clarifications, escalations, and expectation tracking
Requirements
- Experience: 3 to 5+ years in Localization Quality Assurance (LQA), Senior Language Lead, or Quality Governance roles
- Client and stakeholder management: Direct experience as the primary point of contact for client Language Managers, managing formal arbitration or escalation processes, and facilitating conflict resolution
- Quality audit frameworks: Deep, practical experience with localization evaluation frameworks, including RQE, LQE, error rubrics, and severity mapping

title: Test Technician, Electrical and Electronics, 3rd shift, Site 4
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today’s five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

Position Summary:

The Electrical and Electronics Test Technician is responsible for performing functional, environmental, and diagnostic testing on electrical and electronic components, assemblies, and systems. This role ensures all products meet design specifications, quality standards, and regulatory requirements. The technician will work closely with engineers to identify issues, troubleshoot failures, and maintain test equipment.

Key Responsibilities:

• Perform electrical and electronic testing of components, subassemblies, and final products according to engineering specifications and test procedures.

• Operate and maintain automated and manual test equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, signal generators, spectrum analyzers, and specialized test setups.

• Conduct functional, continuity, insulation resistance, hipot, and performance testing.

• Assist in environmental testing, including thermal cycling, vibration, burn-in, and other reliability assessments.

• Interpret schematics, wiring diagrams, test plans, and technical documents to execute test procedures.

• Identify, isolate, and troubleshoot electrical and electronic failures; document findings and recommend corrective actions.

• Record test results accurately in logs, reports, or databases to ensure traceability and compliance.

• Support engineering teams during product development, validation, and qualification activities.

• Maintain calibration, safety, and operational readiness of test stations and equipment.

• Follow all ESD, safety, and cleanroom protocols where applicable.

• Assist in developing and improving test fixtures, setups, and documentation.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues and improve product reliability.

Qualifications:

• Associate degree or technical diploma in Electronics, Electrical Engineering Technology, Mechatronics, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).

• 2+ years of experience in electrical/electronic test environments preferred.

• Strong knowledge of electronic components, analog/digital circuits, and electrical measurement principles.

title: Animator & Motion Graphics Designer
description:
ABOUT POSTHOG

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

- A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking

- PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

- Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog.

 

THINGS WE CARE ABOUT

- Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

- Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

- Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams - autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.

- Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication - PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.

- Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.

WHY THIS ROLE AT POSTHOG NOW?

We have a strong brand and a lot of strong content for you to build on. What we don't have (yet) is someone whose whole job is making it move.

You'll be PostHog's first in-house video animator, and the creative engine behind everything that moves in our visuals.

We take video seriously (although we’re not really so serious https://posthog.com/trash). Our Video team ships documentaries, product launches, ads, social shorts, and more.

Our Infrastructure Architectserves as the critical technical expert responsible for all post-sales deployment and integration of the Epistemix platform into client infrastructure. This is a highly technical, hands-on role.
You will be the vital link between our product's architecture and our clients' varied technical landscapes. About Epistemix
The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.
We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. Getting these decisions right means faster interventions, better-allocated resources, and measurable improvements in human and economic outcomes. We exist to make that possible.
Our platform gives organizations access to realistic, high-resolution population data and the modeling infrastructure to run scenario planning at scale. Together, these capabilities let decision-makers stress-test strategies in a controlled environment before deploying them in the real world across healthcare, consumer industries, insurance, and government. We are approaching our Series B and actively building the team that will define what comes next.

• Experience with data warehouse integrations with Snowflake, Databricks or other data warehouse platforms.

title: Manager, Artist Agreements & Clearances
description:
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
The Manager, Artist Agreements & Clearances is a cross-company role responsible for securing and managing artist agreements, releases, and content clearances in support of production and distribution across the Recording Academy and its affiliates. In this position, you will be a key liaison between internal stakeholders, artists, managers, labels, publishers, and legal teams, supporting events, series, exhibits, GRAMMY Studios programming, and expanding organizational objectives. You are a detail-oriented professional with a genuine passion for music and the music industry. You excel at building and maintaining strong relationships, can balance creative needs with legal and company requirements, and are calm under pressure. You have a collaborative spirit and service mentality.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Artist Releases & Agreements

• Draft, negotiate, execute, and manage artist agreements and releases across all Recording Academy and affiliate productions, ensuring timely execution for live and pre-recorded content.

• Maintain organized records of all agreements, including rights granted, restrictions, and obligations.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to ensure content usage plans and artist negotiations are accurately reflected in contractual terms.

Sync and Misc. Clearances

• Secure synchronization rights and related clearances for music and content use across all Recording Academy and affiliate platforms.

• Coordinate with record labels, publishers, PROs, and other rights holders to obtain necessary licenses.

• Track and manage rights by territory, media, term, and usage to ensure compliance.

• Oversee the license lifecycle, including payments, amendments, extensions, expirations, and archiving

• Troubleshoot and resolve clearance issues under tight production timelines.

• Support additional clearance needs, including artwork, likeness, podcast, and other media usage.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work with internal stakeholders early in the process to assess and address clearance, release, and agreement needs.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for all artist-related contractual and clearance matters.

• Clearly communicate requirements, risks, and timelines to internal and external stakeholders.

Process & Systems Management

• Refine workflows for outreach, negotiations, contract execution, and rights tracking.

• Maintain and improve systems for documenting, tracking, and reporting rights and permissions.

• Keep standardized clearance process resources current and accessible.

• Identify opportunities to streamline processes, improve efficiency, and mitigate risk.

Risk Management & Compliance

• Ensure content is cleared prior to distribution across all platforms.

• Flag risks and escalate issues appropriately.

• Stay current on music rights, licensing practices, and industry standards.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

• Bachelor’s Degree required.

• 5+ years’ experience in music business affairs, content clearance, and music publishing.

• Paralegal experience and/or the ability to draft and review content licensing agreements and negotiate terms with knowledge of how smaller negotiations affect big-picture relationships.

• Established relationships with record labels, music publishers, and artist management.

• Proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese preferred.

• Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and comprehensive follow-through.

• Flexibility to succeed in a fast-paced production environment with tight deadlines.

• Ability to manage multiple projects proactively and independently while providing cross-company support.

title: Amazon Image Brief & Conversion Associate
description:
Amazon images are where most listings win or lose. The main image decides whether anyone clicks. The six behind it decide whether they buy - and whether the parcel comes back.
We are hiring one person to own that. Take a live listing, work out from its reviews and returns why it is not converting, and write the image brief that fixes it - a brief a remote designer can execute without a single follow-up question.
This is an operational and analytical role, not a design role. You will not be making the artwork. You decide what it has to say, in what order, and you hold the returned files to that standard.
The split is 75 / 25.

•
75% - the briefs. The conversion thinking, the ranked USPs, the seven slots, the QA of what comes back.

•
25% - analysis and reporting. Part of it is the work that feeds the brief: pulling the reviews, reading them properly, turning them into a persona and a pain-point list. The rest is the follow-up reporting we owe clients - sales and traffic, return reasons, and what actually moved once new images went live.

You will work across markets. Mostly European and US listings, across many markets and languages, in categories you have never shopped in yourself.
What you will do
Image briefs and conversion thinking - 75% of the role

• Diagnose why a listing is not converting: what the gallery fails to answer, which objection nobody addressed, where the buyer loses confidence and leaves.

• Know what each slot is for. The main image earns the click. Images two to seven answer objections in the order a buyer actually raises them. The size and fit slots decide whether the sale stays sold.

• Rank seven USPs by what wins the click and what prevents a return. They are not the same list, and the order is the decision.

• Write the brief for each slot in our template: one message per slot, one headline, an optional subline, a maximum of three to four callouts, every line adding something new.

• Apply the two-second rule. One idea per image, legible at thumbnail size on a phone. If a slot needs a paragraph to work, it is not a slot.

• Work inside the client’s brand book - colours, fonts, existing assets - naming exactly which asset to reuse and where the file lives.

• Keep sizing accurate and internally consistent: backend size chart against image size chart, US against EU conventions.

• Know Amazon image policy cold: main-image rules, no price, ratings, review counts or badges, and how the gallery renders on a phone.

• QA the returned files against the brief and say precisely why something is not working - hierarchy, contrast, whitespace, text density, whether a close-up box earns its place.

The analysis behind the briefs - part of the 25%

• Download the reviews yourself and read them properly: themes, frequency, and the exact words customers use.

• Pull Voice of the Customer and the return report, and weight return reasons against units actually sold.

• Turn that into a buyer persona and a ranked pain-point list - for categories you did not grow up in.

• Separate “we can fix this on the listing” from “the product is the problem”.

• Evidence only. Never invent a return reason, a measurement or a number, and ask when something is missing.

Reporting that follows up sales - the rest of the 25%

• Find and download the right reports without being walked through it: Sales & Traffic, Search Query Performance, Returns, Voice of the Customer.

• Build the recurring follow-ups: sales and traffic trend, return rate by size, conversion before and after an image update.

• Merge two exports on ASIN or SKU and produce a clean pivot, without hand-counting rows.

• Deliver a one-page summary that says what matters, why it matters and what to do about it. Not a data dump.

Making the workflow better with AI - across all of the above

• Use Claude and ChatGPT as part of the work, not as a novelty: review analysis, first-draft copy, translation, summarising exports.

• Work inside our Claude projects, with the context

We believe innovation should serve people, and we’re committed to creating tools that empower every provider to improve the health, experience, and quality of life of the communities they serve.

POSITION SUMMARY

The IT Technical Support Specialist keeps Colure Health ’s people productive and secure. This role is the first point of contact for technology issues across the executive team, US staff and the international care team in the Philippines, Ecuador and Colombia. It manages devices, accounts and everyday systems, and applies the security controls that protect patient data. As Colure adds clinics and staff, this role will help build repeatable onboarding, offboarding and support processes.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

End-User Support

• Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 support by ticket, chat, phone and remote session for hardware, software, accounts, VoIP and connectivity.

• Troubleshoot issues affecting care coordinators and enrollment staff, including softphones, headsets, CRM and platform access, and home-network problems, often across time zones.

• Document resolutions and maintain the knowledge base and self-help guides.

Accounts and Access

• Provision and deprovision user accounts, email, licenses and application access, in coordination with HR and in line with least-privilege principles.

• Complete same-day access removal at offboarding and support periodic access reviews.

• Administer password resets, MFA enrollment and single sign-on support.

Devices and Assets

• Configure, enroll and maintain laptops and mobile devices in mobile device management (MDM), with encryption, screen lock and endpoint protection enforced.

• Maintain the hardware and software asset inventory, including shipping, retrieval and secure wiping of devices.

• Apply patches and updates, and track compliance with device security standards.

Systems and Security Support

• Administer productivity and collaboration tools, such as Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, the phone system and video conferencing.

• Support the Cybersecurity Specialist with phishing reports, alert triage, and evidence collection for audits.

• Set up technology for new clinic locations, including workstations, printers, networking and peripherals, with vendor coordination as needed.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 2+ years of IT help desk or desktop support experience.

• Hands-on experience with Windows and macOS, Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, and an MDM platform such as Intune, Jamf or Kandji.

• Comfortable supporting remote users, including some international users, by phone, chat and remote-access tools.

• Understanding of basic networking (DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, VPN) and of security practices such as MFA and encryption.

• Clear, patient communication and strong documentation habits.

• Ability to work a schedule that covers part of US Eastern Time business hours, with occasional after-hours support.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• CompTIA A+, Network+ or Security+, or Google IT Support certification.

• Experience in a healthcare or other HIPAA-regulated environment.

Our strategic acquisitions of ARES, COIL, and ABL (a leading German EV charger manufacturer) have solidified our position as a trailblazer in the EV charging market.
Join us to power the future of electric vehicles!
About the Role
The mission of the Sales Executive is to establish and grow the company’s footprint in new or developing markets by managing the full sales cycle and adapting the go-to-market approach to local market maturity and opportunities.
Key Responsibilities

• Map the market landscape (partners, customers, competitors, regulations).

• Identify and recruit channel partners (distributors, VARs, installers) to secure market access.

• Engage directly with corporate accounts, fleets, real estate developers, hospitality, utilities, and public sector buyers.

• Conduct prospecting (calls, meetings, events) to generate new opportunities.

• Collaborate with marketing to adapt campaigns to local needs.

Customer Profiles:

• Distributors and VARs (for channel reach)

• Installers & Electrical Contractors (sell-out execution)

• Corporate Fleets, Real Estate, Hospitality, Retail (direct accounts)

• Utilities & Energy Companies

• Public Sector (municipalities, government projects, tenders)

Key Requirements

• 4-6 years of B2B sales experience, ideally in technical products, mobility, or renewable energy.

• Proven track record in both channel management and direct account acquisition.

• Strong hunter mentality: able to prospect, build pipeline, and win new accounts.

• Also capable of farmer skills: managing partner or account relationships to grow revenue.

• Experience working in new or developing markets (resourceful, adaptable, entrepreneurial).

• Comfortable managing diverse sales motions: channel enablement, tender participation, direct solution selling.

• Swedish and English fluency is required.

Why Join Wallbox ?
Join a global leader in EV charging and play a pivotal role in the electric vehicle revolution. At Wallbox , you’ll work with cutting-edge EV charging infrastructure, collaborate with a passionate team, and drive sustainable impact. If you thrive on hunting new business and are excited about shaping the future of electric vehicles, we want you on our team!

title: CAD Solution Design New Business Projects
description:
Die Kardex Gruppe gehört zu den weltweit führenden Herstellern dynamischer Lager- und Distributionssysteme und beschäftigt über 2.900 Mitarbeitende. Kardex Mlog, ein Teil der Gruppe, ist auf integrierte Materialflusssysteme und automatisierte Hochregallager spezialisiert. Seit mehr als 50 Jahren entwickeln wir Lösungen zur Steigerung von Effizienz und Produktivität in der Intralogistik.

Als CAD Solution Designer setzen Sie vorgegebene Planungskonzepte für intralogistische Anlagen in präzise 3D-CAD-Layouts um. Mit Autodesk Inventor und Factory Design Utilities (FDU) erstellen Sie technische Zeichnungen für Budget-, Angebots- und Auftragsphasen. Dabei arbeiten Sie wahlweise in Neuenstadt am Kocher oder zu 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Your tasks

• Erstellung von 3D-Planungs- und Konzeptlayouts für intralogistische Anlagen mit Autodesk Inventor und Factory Design Utilities (FDU) auf Basis vorgegebener Planungsdaten

• Erstellung maßstäblicher und nachvollziehbarer CAD-Layouts zur Unterstützung von Budget-, Angebots- und Auftragsphasen

• Übertragung abgestimmter Anlagenkonzepte in detaillierte 3D-CAD-Zeichnungen

• Pflege und Aktualisierung von Auftragslayouts auf Basis freigegebener Änderungen in Abstimmung mit Solution Design und den zuständigen Fachabteilungen

• Integration und Positionierung standardisierter Anlagenkomponenten aus der Kardex -Intralogistik-Bibliothek in Inventor FDU

• Prüfung der Zeichnungen auf geometrische Plausibilität, Vollständigkeit und Kollisionsfreiheit sowie Einhaltung der geltenden CAD-Standards

• Mitarbeit beim Aufbau und bei der Pflege der Inventor-FDU-Bibliothek, insbesondere standardisierter CAD-Komponenten und Vorlagen

Your profile

• Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Erstellung technischer 3D-CAD-Zeichnungen mit Autodesk Inventor

• Fundierte Erfahrung mit Factory Design Utilities (FDU) und der Erstellung von Anlagenlayouts ; sicherer Umgang mit großen Baugruppen, Layern, Referenzen, Bibliothekskomponenten und Zeichnungsableitungen

•
Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung , z. B. als Technischer Produktdesigner, Technischer Zeichner oder Konstrukteur, oder ein technisches Studium mit ausgeprägtem CAD-Schwerpunkt

• Sehr gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen, hohe Zeichnungsgenauigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

•
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse für die Arbeit mit technischen Unterlagen, Softwareoberflächen und internationalen CAD-Standards

• Kenntnisse im Intralogistik-Umfeld von Vorteil

• Grundlagenkenntnisse in Autodesk Navisworks, ReCap Professional und iLogic wünschenswert

Was wir bieten

•
Unternehmenskultur: Respekt, Teamgeist, Zuverlässigkeit und Leidenschaft prägen unsere Zusammenarbeit. Ein positives, familiäres Betriebsklima hat höchste Priorität.

•
Langfristige Perspektiven: Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachstumsstarken, internationalen Unternehmen mit spannenden Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

•
Wertvolle Unterstützung: Umfassender Onboarding-Prozess, Weiterbildungsangebote und ein starkes Team.

•
Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Gleitzeitregelung, 35-Stunden-Woche, 6 Wochen Urlaub, Sonderurlaube sowie die Möglichkeit, zu 100 % remote innerhalb Deutschlands zu arbeiten.

•
Attraktive Vergütung: IG Metall tarifgebundene Bezahlung inklusive Jahressonderzahlung sowie betriebliche Altersvorsorge.

•
Zusätzliche Benefits: Firmenfitness (Hansefit), Firmenveranstaltungen, Jubiläumsprämien, Bike-Leasing, Gesundheitsmanagement (Obsttage, Massagen), Mittagessenszuschuss, kostenfreie Parkplätze u.v.m.
